# 1. Introduction

R is a programming language used for data
analysis, statistical computing, and data
visualization.

# 2. Installing and Loading Packages
R packages are collections of functions, datasets, and tools that extend the capabilities of R. They help users perform different tasks, such as importing data, cleaning data, statistical analysis, and visualization.

```{r}
# Install required packages

install.packages(c(
  "tidyverse",
  "readxl",
  "jsonlite",
  "DBI",
  "haven"
))
```
# load the package

```{r}
# Load the required packages

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)
library(DBI)
library(haven)
```
install.packages("RSQLite")
library(RSQLite)
#Vector 
marks<-c(20,35,32,29)
summary(marks)
mean(marks)
# Create a sample student dataset

students <- data.frame(
  StudentID = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
  Name = c("Aline", "Rose", "Eric", "Jean", "Marie"),
  Age = c(22, 24, 21, 23, 25),
  Marks = c(75, 85, 68, 90, 80)
)

# Export the dataset to CSV

write.csv(students, "students.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Import the CSV file

data_csv <- read.csv("students.csv")

# Display the imported data

print(data_csv)

# Display the first six rows

head(data_csv)

# Check the structure

str(data_csv)
